items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 21:1
items.html: Before the sin he had the discernment of NRN of Atzilut, occupying the level of the three worlds BYA, which had already then become NRN of Atzilut. And after the sin he was diminished in two [ways]: first, that he descended below the Parsa of Atzilut together with BYA; and second, that only one hundred souls remained to him from them, from the ten Partzufim of BYA, as above in answer 20. (Part 1, Page 957, Sub Header, "and this").
